coreRisk.headline: Outdated documentation is silently draining your portfolio.
coreRisk.body: Most asset managers are working with floor plans that are years out of date. When a refurbishment exceeds budget or a tenant fit-out hits unexpected walls, the root cause is usually the same: the data you trusted was wrong. That gap between what's documented and what's real is where costs accumulate — and compound.

friction.headline: The friction you've learned to live with

point0.title: Repeated site visits
point0.description: Every maintenance cycle, refurbishment quote, or lease review triggers another survey. The same properties get measured again and again.

point1.title: Version chaos across teams
point1.description: Architects, contractors, and facility managers work from different drawings. Discrepancies surface late — and expensively.

point2.title: No single source of truth
point2.description: Documentation is scattered across email threads, old CAD files, and outdated PDFs. No one knows which version is current.

valueA.title: Reduce rework costs
valueA.description: Precise as-built data means fewer surprises during construction or fit-out — and far fewer costly change orders.

valueB.title: Accelerate every project phase
valueB.description: When teams start from verified data, planning cycles shorten, approvals move faster, and on-site surprises drop.

differentiator.headline: You shouldn't need to resurvey the same property twice.
differentiator.subheadline: Rescan delivers scan-to-BIM outputs that your entire team can trust — for the full lifecycle of the asset.

namedCase.label: Case Study
namedCase.headline: One portfolio. One source of truth.
namedCase.body: A Nordic asset manager standardised on Rescan across 250+ properties. The result: a single verified dataset shared across all project teams — from day one of every refurbishment cycle. Change orders dropped. Planning timelines shortened. Rework costs fell.
